NODE: Another Factory Game — Audio

Piano player-action cues:
Salamander Grand Piano V3 by Alexander Holm, licensed CC BY 3.0. Modified for NODE: selected velocity-10 notes, first four seconds converted from 24-bit FLAC to 16-bit stereo WAV; arranged, repitched and released as interaction cues.
Source: https://sfzinstruments.github.io/pianos/salamander/
License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/

Ambient cello and double bass:
Quiet Workshop · Ambient Strings: original string-only arrangement for NODE.
Cello: VSCO 2 Community Edition — Cello Section. Bass: VSCO 2 Community Edition — Solo Contrabass.
Both by Versilian Studios / Sam Gossner, CC0 1.0.
https://github.com/sgossner/VSCO-2-CE
